details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: segmentation violation in FNT_Size_Request
     - debian/patches-freetype/CVE-2022-27405.patch: properly guard
       face_index in FT_Open_Face in src/base/ftobjs.c.
     - CVE-2022-27405
   * SECURITY UPDATE: segmentation violation in FT_Request_Size
     - debian/patches-freetype/CVE-2022-27406.patch: guard face->size in
       FT_Request_Size in src/base/ftobjs.c.
     - CVE-2022-27406
   * SECURITY UPDATE: out-of-bounds write when parsing composite subglyphs
     of TrueType GX / variable fonts
     - debian/patches-freetype/CVE-2025-27363.patch: reject a subglyph count
       that truncates to a negative short in load_truetype_glyph before it
       is used to size the outline arrays in src/truetype/ttgload.c.
     - CVE-2025-27363
